theorems.name: Submission.dtc_cwv_scaled_action_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => R.action (fun y => (s ^ n) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (s • y))) (R.action (fun y => ((n : ℝ) * t ^ (n - 1)) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t • y) + (t ^ n) • fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t • y) y)) t
